svg.aria-label: Zoe second eye · synthetic stereo depth and defocus
svg.title: Zoe second eye · synthetic stereo depth and defocus

g.title: subtitle
g.text: Synthetic stereo · two projections · one depth estimate · explicit uncertainty

g.title: optics
g.text: 50mm virtual lens · 36mm sensor · no physical camera

g.title: depth-caption
g.text: SYNTHETIC DEPTH / measured disparity -> recovered distance

g.title: uncertainty-note
g.text: Depth is triangulated from known synthetic geometry; uncertainty is first-order disparity sensitivity, not a belief score.

g.title: optics-note
g.text: Defocus rings show approximate circle-of-confusion radius, not a physical blur kernel. No macro optics, camera capture, or subjective sight.
